name: Chicago Green Ambassadors Summer Program
org: The Field Museum, Keller Science Action Center (Roots and Routes Initiative and Youth Conservation Action)
what_you_do: Paid summer interns link their neighborhoods with the Burnham Wildlife Corridor. It is a nature area on the south lakefront. Interns work on real problems in the environment and in the community.
who_can_apply: Students ages 15 to 22 who live in Chinatown, Bronzeville, Little Village, Pilsen or nearby. You want to link your area to the south lakefront. That is McCormick Place to 47th Street.
pay_detail: Paid internship. The page does not state the rate.
deadline_text: Dates and application not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the program page. Check the Keller Science Action Center page linked from the Field Museum teen page.
notes: Open to ages 15 to 22, so younger teens and college-age students may be in the same group. Confirm dates and pay before relying on this.
